issue: gʷh₂mé ('went away') is aor. 1pl 'we went'; subject is ḱuh₁rósyo kóryos (3sg), needs gʷéh₂t. Also ḱérd as acc. of neuter 'heart' (nom. is ḱḗr elsewhere; neuter nom=acc, *ḱḗr).
liǵʰént ('licked') is 3pl, subject márkos is singular; needs 3sg léyǵʰt.

wĺ̥kʷos dwóh₁ bʰréh₂tēr-kʷe: bʰréh₂tēr is nom. sg with the numeral 'two'; needs dual bʰréh₂terh₁ (used correctly later in the same text). Also nébʰōs as nom. pl. of neuter s-stem *nébʰos is not standard (expected *nébʰesh₂).
tósyeh₂ey-kʷe wéwketu: imperative 3sg 'let him say', but the order is to the brother (2sg) 'and say to her'; needs 2sg wéwke.
